trust_decision.summary: Which telemetry metadata fields are written into the file-backed business log (later readable via the admin logs API); at the pinned commit BorutaWeb.Logger writes bearer credentials (access/refresh/agent tokens, authorization codes, id/vp tokens, introspected/revoked tokens) verbatim via log_attribute.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'OAuth credentials exposed in Boruta business logs'; the business-log handler module of the OAuth app is the obvious place, and the token success handler is the most prominent credential log line.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /openid/direct_post/:code_id (event emitted by external boruta lib, not in repo)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Fix also strips credentials from telemetry metadata in apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/controllers/oauth/authorize_controller.ex:427-428 and apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/controllers/oauth/token_controller.ex:29-33, but these are producers in the same app; fixing logger.ex alone already closes the log leak, so they are not a separate out-of-scope sink.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The identity app's confirmation-token logging (apps/boruta_identity/lib/boruta_identity/logger.ex:265,291) is in a different umbrella app and concerns account-confirmation tokens, not 'OAuth credentials' as the advisory title says.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-secret attributes on the same log lines must keep being logged and parseable by the admin log viewer: client_id, sub, code_id (an identifier next to the secret code), token_type next to access_token, expires_in, active, response_type/requested_scope (quoted), error_description; dropping whole lines or handlers breaks admin business-log display/filtering.

O6_input_shapes: credential keys pattern-matched in handler heads (access_token, code, agent_token, refresh_token, token) at apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/logger.ex:108-116,172-180,273-278,302-306,329-331,351-356
credential keys read optionally via Access (metadata[:authorization_code], metadata[:code], metadata[:id_token], metadata[:vp_token]) at apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/logger.ex:195,242,245-246
nil vs present value (log_attribute drops nil) at apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/logger.ex:376-377

O7_producer.where: Controllers that build telemetry metadata with credentials: apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/controllers/oauth/introspect_controller.ex:18-28, apps/boruta_web/lib/boruta_web/controllers/oauth/revoke_controller.ex:17-24 (left unchanged by the fix), authorize_controller.ex:427-428 and token_controller.ex:29-33 (changed).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Account confirmation token (bearer secret from email link) written to identity business log on confirm success
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different umbrella app (boruta_identity) and an account-confirmation token, not an OAuth credential named by the advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Different app/package from the landing point (apps/boruta_identity vs apps/boruta_web); emitted at apps/boruta_identity/lib/boruta_identity_web/controllers/user_confirmation_controller.ex:54

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Account confirmation token written to identity business log on confirm failure
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; additionally a failed/invalid token may be argued harmless.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Request logger writes full request path, which carries confirmation and reset-password tokens as path segments
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Request log rather than business log; standard path logging; tokens are not OAuth credentials (routes at apps/boruta_identity/lib/boruta_identity_web/router.ex:77-79).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SiopV2/VerifiablePresentation direct_post authorize_success branches carry '# TODO log business event'; a planted event logging response.code.value would be a natural sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainer TODOs explicitly ask for business events there, mirroring the existing authorize success event that logged code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a direct_post telemetry event in-repo that passes id_token/vp_token from params
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The direct_post handlers exist in logger.ex:230-268 but the emitter lives in the external lib; an in-repo emitter is a plausible refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: gateway proxy business log adding an authorization header / forwarded token attribute
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gateway proxies bearer tokens to upstreams; logging the token for debugging is a common addition and would sit in another package.

O10_build.toolchain: mix umbrella (Phoenix, Ecto); boruta lib fetched from git (apps/boruta_auth/mix.exs:27)
services: PostgreSQL (for controller tests; logger unit tests are pure)
O10_build.project_tests: apps/boruta_web/test/boruta_web/logger_test.exs calls handlers directly with capture_log; controller tests in apps/boruta_web/test/boruta_web/controllers/oauth/ (introspect_test.exs, revoke_test.exs, direct_post_test.exs) need DB.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove access_token/refresh_token from the token success handler only (the report's example), leaving authorize code, direct_post id/vp tokens, introspect/revoke token and the identity confirmation token logged.

out_of_scope_notes: Telemetry metadata still carries raw tokens after the fix (introspect_controller.ex:27, revoke_controller.ex:23); any other attached handler would see them.
